cases.title: Missing filing confirmation — court deadline today
cases.focus: Locate docket evidence and give a timed next step without over-promising.
cases.brief: Client says the filing confirmation was never emailed. Deadline is today 4:00 p.m. Prior contact promised a callback that did not happen. Verify identity, check case file / statements-equivalent records, escalate to Paralegal Ops if outside authority.
cases.clientStatement: This is the third time I call. Where is my filing confirmation? Court is today.

cases.title: Notary appointment — wrong venue on file
cases.focus: Correct venue data, confirm entitlement, never invent availability.
cases.brief: Client needs a same-day notary. CRM shows downtown venue; client is at airport. Verify identity, update itinerary notes, route to Concierge/Legal Ops with owner + time.
cases.clientStatement: Your system still shows downtown. I am at the airport. Fix this.
